rules.name: no-hardcoded-secrets
rules.description: Do not hardcode secrets, passwords, API keys, or tokens in source files. Use environment variables or a secrets manager.

rules.name: no-console-in-production
rules.description: Do not use console.log/warn/error in production source files. Use a structured logging library instead.

rules.name: no-eval
rules.description: Do not use eval() — it enables code injection attacks. Use safer alternatives like JSON.parse() or Function constructors with validated input.

rules.name: no-sql-string-concat
rules.description: Do not build SQL queries with string concatenation or template literals. Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.

rules.name: no-any-type
rules.description: Avoid using 'any' type in TypeScript. Use specific types, generics, or 'unknown' for type safety.
